prompts: A medium shot inside a 24-hour convenience store at night, heavy rain hammering the glass front. A lean, long-faced young man with prominent cheekbones, short black messy hair wet and plastered on his forehead, a faint scar at the tail of his left eyebrow, wearing a dark blue store vest over a grey long-sleeve tee with a crooked name badge on his left chest, stands at the checkout counter, head down, sorting products on the shelf. His hands suddenly freeze mid-motion. He lifts his head slowly, eyes narrowing with alert suspicion, and turns his gaze toward the rain-streaked glass door. Cold fluorescent overhead light, deep blue-black night beyond the glass, rain reflections sliding down the pane. Fixed camera slowly pushes in toward the counter. Landscape 832x480.

A lanky young man with a thin long face, prominent cheekbones, wet black short choppy hair plastered on his forehead, and a faint scar at the end of his left eyebrow, wearing a dark blue convenience-store vest over a grey long-sleeve T-shirt with a crooked name badge on his left chest, walks slowly out from behind a checkout counter toward a glass door. He is inside a brightly lit 24-hour convenience store at night. Outside the glass, in torrential rain, a blurry soaked figure in a dark hooded raincoat stands motionless, shoulders broader than the clerk's, hood pulled low, pale chin visible, water dripping from the hem. Handheld wide shot, slight shake, cool fluorescent light inside, cold blue-black night outside, rain streaks on glass, tense and uneasy.

A tight close-up on a rain-streaked convenience store glass door at night, landscape frame. In the reflection stands a soaked figure in a dark hooded raincoat, hood pulled low, pale chin visible, water dripping from the hem — shoulders slightly broader than the man facing him. Beside it, the reflection of a lean young man with a long thin face, prominent cheekbones, wet black short choppy hair plastered on his forehead, a faint scar at the left eyebrow tail, wearing a dark blue store vest over a gray long-sleeve tee, crooked name badge on the left chest. The clerk spins around sharply — the real space behind him is empty. Fluorescent greenish light, cold blue rain darkness, slow push-in.

A low-angle close-up inside a convenience store at night, shot on a 832x480 landscape canvas. Lin Mo, a thin-faced young man with prominent cheekbones, wet black short hair sticking to his forehead, a faint scar at the end of his left eyebrow, wearing a dark blue convenience store vest over a gray long-sleeve T-shirt, a crooked name badge on his left chest, turns back toward the glass door. Outside, a figure in a dripping dark hooded raincoat, hood pulled low, pale chin visible, shoulders broader than Lin Mo's, presses a wet palm flat against the glass; water streaks run down. Lin Mo reaches out and turns the lock, but the lock is jammed shut from outside. Fluorescent light from inside contrasts with dark rainy street outside. The camera pushes in slowly from his hands toward the figure beyond the glass. Fear escalates.

A medium shot in a narrow convenience store aisle at night, under cold flickering fluorescent light, with a 832x480 landscape frame. A thin-faced young man, about 24-28, with prominent cheekbones, wet black short choppy hair plastered on his forehead, a faint scar at the tail of his left eyebrow, wearing a dark blue store vest over a grey long-sleeve T-shirt, a crooked name badge on his left chest, black work pants and white sneakers, stumbles backward and slams into a shelf; bags of chips scatter and the shelf shudders. The camera, handheld, retreats with him then jolts to a stop and slowly pushes in. Behind him, reflected in the dark glass door, a dripping figure in a deep black hooded raincoat, shoulders broader than his, hood pulled low, pale chin exposed, slowly lifts its head — under the hood appears the young man's own face, grinning. The shot tightens toward the reflection.
